[B] Diagram
=============================================================
Diagram (readonly; repository-independent)
  +-- diagramId   stable service identity
  +-- revisionId  service revision identity
  +-- id          local scene.contents key
  +-- revision    nonnegative integer
  |
  +-- content: DiagramContent
  |    +-- revisionId = id:revision / ascii / asciiSha256
  |    '-- structure
  |         +-- kind: diagram
  |         '-- kind: tree
  |              +-- parserVersion: ascii-tree-1 | ascii-tree-2
  |              +-- rootIds
  |              '-- nodes[id]: DiagramContentNode
  |                   label / line / branchColumn
  |                   startColumn / endColumn
  |                   parentId? / childIds / foldRanges
  |
  +-- sourceContext: DiagramSourceContext
  |    +-- contentHash = SHA256(content.ascii)
  |    +-- binding?: sourceId / repositoryIdentity
  |    |    '-- corpus + domainProfileId
  |    |         source-code <-> git-worktree
  |    |         document    <-> filesystem-documents
  |    +-- mappings[]: diagram span -> entityId + range index
  |    '-- evidence[entityId] -> sourceRanges[]
  |         relative path / startLine / endLine / originalLines
  |
  '-- jumps?: DiagramJump[]
       |
validateDiagram -> canonical content + hash + binding
                   jumps + local mappings + evidence joins
diagramSource -> entries / forSelection / search
visibleContentLines(content, collapsedIds) -> folded line set
  unknown tree node ID -> STALE_CONTENT_NODE
-------------------------------------------------------------
